controlled_recovery_simulations.scope: Controlled provider/ASR scheduling, failures, cancellation and single-winner tool proposals. No live paid integrations, physical microphone, Windows speech or image rendering.

checks: compiled App plays first audio before complete provider response
measured start under five seconds with controlled 150 ms AI / 100 ms TTS fixtures
timing history is reachable from the stopwatch and records a single turn
Escape cancels pending server generation and logs cancellation
failed request stays in history instead of disappearing from measurements
next question responds after cancellation and failure, without a stale lock
AudioWorklet manual send includes actual ASR and endpoint delay in the same question timer
one receipt ID follows actual microphone bytes through recognition, AI, Fish response and playback
ASR failure is recorded even when no chat request can be sent
same recording is resent after ASR failure, its actual transcript reaches AI and the answer reaches TTS
13-second recognition completes and reaches real audio playback instead of being aborted at the old 12-second deadline
9-second synthesis finishes with audible playback instead of being killed by the former 8-second voice deadline
TTS failure keeps the open Language panel unchanged, retains the error past final AI metadata, and only opens written cards when requested
native audio leaves transcription state on handoff, receives its recognized question and speaks before final metadata
native answer failure preserves the actual recognized question for retry, without redundant ASR or the voice placeholder
diagnostic button submits a fresh arithmetic question and plays the computed answer using the same backend and TTS path
diagnostic stays copyable when the embedded browser does not provide clipboard permission
open-window microphone ASR reaches AI and the identical complete response is read by controlled device voice when online TTS fails; no panel popup or closure
10-second online synthesis hedge reads the actual answer locally and a late online completion does not restart speech
hung AudioContext activation is bounded and reads the same response through device speech instead of leaving generating forever
Escape cancels active device speech without replaying a queued continuation or changing to another voice
no Fish model and no browser voices: compiled UI plays the actual answer through the Windows WAV fallback contract
metadata failure after a complete reply preserves answer playback and reports unconfirmed persistence instead of cancelling the voice
compiled_browser_conversation.environment: Chromium + compiled UI + real local FastAPI/HTTP + real SSE parser and WAV playback; external AI and TTS controlled, synthetic microphone, controlled ASR/AI/TTS, no physical Windows microphone/speaker validation

scenarios: 12 decoded unique images despite failures and duplicate pixels
fullscreen wall moves left, three rows, no transcript
streaming text does not restart identical media searches
spoken Plato changes the subject instead of retaining Socrates
late cancelled search cannot overwrite a newer topic
empty search is not permanently cached; retry recovers
all proxy failures report failure and allow working retry
new page of images is requested while narration continues
portrait photographs adapt to two rows without forced cropping
small viewport preserves all photographs and a reachable close button
closing releases every object URL with no browser errors
main App sends a study question, plays real WAV and renews images during speech

checks: real loopback backend starts without creating a browser or visible WebView
authenticated assistant state exposes a shared session and separates name activation from opening
closing and reopening two controlled desktop views keeps the real backend alive
both desktop views reuse the same non-private WebView profile; no permission auto-grant is installed
explicit shutdown removes the private endpoint and terminates the resident
a restarted backend preserves its origin/port and rotates its private access token
resident_lifecycle.environment: Real Python subprocess + Uvicorn/HTTP lifecycle on Linux, controlled WebView API. Windows microphone/camera permission persistence not physically validated.

wake_without_repeating_name.scope: PASS: actual voice without a wake word sends no cloud/ASR request; a woken question closes with continuous noise in 1362 ms after speech stops; exactly one request, microphone stays open, and a fresh phrase needs a new wake word. Keyword/provider responses mocked.

network_validation.reason: Current managed policy restricts external destinations; Gemini/Fish are not allowlisted and no provider credentials are bound to this environment. No policy bypass attempted.

notes: Controlled simulations include expected authentication denials and explicit cancellations. They are not 10,000 successful calls to real cloud accounts.
Actual Chromium WAV playback and real local HTTP backend were exercised; AI/ASR/TTS were controlled.
Windows SAPI process payload, WAV output contract and child termination were verified with process fixtures. No physical Windows SAPI execution occurred.
No universal zero-error or fixed-latency guarantee.
